review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: Implement the user-selected second Knowledge detail concept in the existing shared native App
review.notes: Exact option2 selected by user; use the existing design tokens, native sheet/chrome, shared anchored menu and icon set. No new raster asset, dependency, route or KB rewrite. Lead content is literal entry prose, never generated summary; explicit history headings may fold but every original character remains readable. Existing action eligibility, CAS revision, destination and mutation semantics stay unchanged. Fresh review explicitly includes KnowledgeSheet.test.tsx: update only the now-required menu-open/dismiss interaction steps for secondary actions while preserving all existing payload/revision/refusal/ordering assertions and their prior KBCARRIER-REVISION mapping. New read feedback must fence entry/scope, include a whole-read deadline, and never imply an empty/successful read on error. Component and synthetic transport checks cannot certify native typography/visual or VoiceOver; visual handoff remains blocked until same-state native capture and comparison.

cases.description: Knowledge reading sections retain source and separate explicit history from current guidance
cases.setup: Synthetic bilingual prose, explicit history headings, arbitrary headings, code fences with history-like text, empty/leading list/code and long leading paragraph
cases.action: Split the display-only body into literal leading guidance, current detail and historical section
cases.expected: Every source character is retained in ordered slices; no summary is invented or truncated. Only explicit history headings outside fenced code fold. Unknown shapes remain whole in the body; alternate-language resolution precedes segmentation. Code/examples never become invented guidance.

cases.description: Selected reading hierarchy on compact and regular layouts, both themes
cases.setup: Production KnowledgeSheet with synthetic entry, leading guidance, current detail, long historical section and full provenance/use metadata
cases.action: Open, expand/collapse body/history/details, then switch entry and language
cases.expected: Title, compact real use state and literal core guidance lead; current detail opens by default, historical and record details fold by default and reveal original content on demand. No duplicated leading paragraph or missing source facts. One shared reader supports compact/regular themes, reading-width cap and wrapping labels. Entry changes reset local disclosure state.

cases.description: One eligible primary action and secondary actions through the existing anchored menu
cases.setup: Synthetic pending everyone/HQ/machine/repo/unknown and nonpending entries, deferred menu dismissal and action observer
cases.action: Open secondary menu, choose retire/withdraw/land where eligible, dismiss; use primary feedback/carry/land; change viewed revision/scope before a delayed callback
cases.expected: Only existing actsFor eligibility is offered. One primary action when available; secondary/retire are not equal-weight page buttons. Menu operations wait for dismissal, preserve exact viewed revision and never apply across a changed entry/scope. External feedback opens only the existing draft URL, without claiming an issue was created. Existing confirmation/draft/error guards remain.

cases.description: Existing Knowledge behaviors remain through the redesigned secondary-action path
cases.setup: Unchanged synthetic index/search/navigation/promotion fixtures from existing KnowledgeSheet tests
cases.action: Add explicit More/menu-dismiss steps only where the action moved; execute all existing assertions
cases.expected: Keep every prior source/revision/payload/duplicate-submit/refusal/draft/eligibility expectation. A recorded application remains visible once in a compact status line. No old assertion is removed or weakened merely to pass the redesign.

cases.description: Knowledge detail loading/retry is scoped and does not erase a readable revision
cases.setup: Controlled pending, wrong-ID, rejected and stalled reads plus actual client/scope switches and successful mutation followed by failed refresh; no live server or KB
cases.action: Open A then B; close/switch scope; Retry; advance whole-read deadline; deliver late responses; refresh existing content
cases.expected: Initial loading has explicit copy; a failure is actionable with visible retry progress, never false empty. Whole read times out at15s and late/disposed/wrong-ID results cannot fill the current reader. Last readable content remains during refresh. Pending mutations cannot cross readScope; original act payload/CAS semantics remain. No automatic mutation or retry-send is added.
